title: Approximate Uniformity in Finite Convolution Models
summary: The problem of the uniform law being a sum of two independent distributions has been well studied. Here, we study the approximation of the uniform law to a sum of two distributions with fixed support, under the following discrepancies: the Manhattan distance, the Euclidean distance, the forward Kullback--Leibler divergence and the Wasserstein-one distance based on the line metric. The problem of membership of the uniform law in this model has been well studied.
